title: Blanket 64-bit stack-usage relaxation should be per-file; rationale cited wrong function
description: 84dfe84451 relaxed -Wstack-usage to 4096 for CONFIG_64BIT globally citing monocypher blake2s; measured offender is crypto_argon2 (2464B, monocypher.c:749) and blanket relax admits any first-party 2-4KB frame on 64-bit silently. Prefer set_source_files_properties(monocypher.c) exception keeping 2048 for first-party code.
close_reason: lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt: blanket relaxation removed, -Wstack-usage=2048 unconditional for first-party code on all word sizes (CONFIG_64BIT conditional deleted, comment corrected: offender is crypto_argon2 monocypher.c:749, not blake2s). crypto/CMakeLists.txt: set_source_files_properties(monocypher.c COMPILE_OPTIONS -Wno-error=stack-usage=) - trailing '=' required, GCC rejects unparameterized -Wno-error=stack-usage (verified empirically on AWS gcc 11.5). Warning stays VISIBLE: successful link_crypto build now prints 'monocypher.c:749:6: warning: stack usage is 3424 bytes [-Wstack-usage=]' and continues (3424B on AWS gcc11 vs 2464B measurement cited in bead - comment records both). Verified: link_crypto 18/18 PASS with 2048 blanket + per-file exception.
